item.title: Anthropic Open-Sources FlashProve to Verify Model Origin via zkSNARK
item.description:
Anthropic released FlashProve, an open-source research prototype using zkSNARK cryptography to verify that AI responses originate from the claimed model without exposing weights. It addresses trust issues like silent model swapping or data tampering but currently only supports greedy decoding (highest probability token), limiting its applicability to standard randomized chatbot outputs.

原文标题：Anthropic 开源 FlashProve 用 zkSNARK 验证模型来源

Why it matters：提供了大模型推理溯源的密码学解决方案，虽处于早期阶段但具有显著的技术创新性和行业参考价值。

item.title: LiberAI Releases Liber-0: Glove Data Replaces Robot Demos
item.description:
Chinese startup LiberAI released Liber-0, a robot foundation model trained on data from lightweight sensor gloves. It achieved a 36% success rate on new tasks without any robot demonstrations. Experiments showed that 10K hours of glove motion data outperformed 2M hours of internet video, significantly lowering the barrier for embodied AI data acquisition.

原文标题：LiberAI 发布 Liber-0 模型 手套数据替代机器人演示

Why it matters：该事件提出了“以人手动作数据替代机器人遥操作”的新范式，且提供了具体的量化对比证据（手套数据 vs 视频数据），对具身智能领域具有较高参考价值。

item.title: Leaked Anthropic Fable 5.5 Generates Animation via Pure Code in 2 Hours
item.description:
Developers leaked early tests of Anthropic's unreleased flagship model, Claude Fable 5.5, which generated a full animation by running code autonomously for over two hours without external assets. This demonstration highlights the shift from code completion to long-horizon autonomous execution, though official confirmation and standardized benchmarks are still pending.

item.description:

item.title: US Voters Reject Data Centers in Ballot Measures
item.description:
In November 2026, voters across more than 30 localities in nine US states overwhelmingly rejected data center projects or imposed strict constraints via ballot measures. This outcome poses a significant headwind to the ongoing AI infrastructure buildout, forcing tech companies to reassess siting strategies and attempt rebranding efforts to mitigate public resistance.

item.title: Tao Warns of AI Outsourcing Risk, Advocates Math 2.0 Era
item.description:
Fields Medalist Terence Tao warns that outsourcing problem-solving to AI risks eroding human understanding of underlying logic. He highlights dangers in real-world domains like power grids and chip design where AI may exploit model loopholes, advocating for a 'Math 2.0' paradigm that prioritizes human verification and judgment over mere answer generation.

原文标题：陶哲轩警告 AI 替代思考风险 呼吁转向 Math 2.0

Why it matters：顶级数学家对 AI 认知外包风险的权威警示，涉及关键基础设施安全与科研范式变革，具有极高的行业反思价值。

item.title: Living Brain Decouples Memory into Independent Layer for Cross-Model Sharing
item.description:
Living Brain decouples AI memory from reasoning models to create an independent persistent storage layer. It enables shared context across ChatGPT, Claude, and custom agents via MCP or APIs, reducing task costs by up to 95% and token usage by 22.6x through precise retrieval of relevant memories instead of full history.

原文标题：Living Brain 将记忆解耦为独立层，支持跨模型共享与低成本检索

Why it matters：解决了多模型间记忆孤岛问题，并提供了显著的成本优化数据，对构建长期运行 Agent 的开发者具有较高参考价值。

item.title: Jaron Lanier Warns AI Repeats Social Media Mistakes
item.description:
Tech thinker Jaron Lanier argues in a podcast that current AI development is repeating the negative patterns of social media. He warns that without respect for data ownership and human agency, AI may exacerbate polarization and information manipulation. The discussion focuses on tech ethics and societal impact rather than technical breakthroughs.

item.title: Xiaomi Deploys WorldCast Framework on Redmi K100 for Photo-to-3D Video Generation
item.description:
Xiaomi has deployed the WorldCast visual generation framework on the Redmi K100 smartphone. The system converts static photos into 3D scenes by interpreting depth structures and simulates real camera trajectories to generate dynamic videos with consistent subject appearance. This marks a transition from research paper to on-device product implementation in controllable visual generation.

item.title: Nebius Shares Drop as Texas Votes to Pause Data Center Permits
item.description:
Nebius Group shares fell up to 5% following a Texas election that empowered Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa to pause new data center permits. Although Nebius has no disclosed facilities in Texas, investors feared the halt would impact the state's 27% share of planned U.S. capacity, triggering a broader sell-off in GPU cloud stocks like CoreWeave.

item.title: ByteDance Pauses Coze Enterprise Sales for Product Integration
item.description:
ByteDance's AI development platform Coze has paused new sales of its enterprise edition to facilitate product integration and upgrades. Existing customers retain service during their contract terms, with legacy plans retiring by end-2026 and new enterprise plans by end-2027. This move reflects ByteDance's strategy to consolidate tools like TRAE and Coze into the Doubao ecosystem, restructuring its Agent productivity portfolio.

item.description:
Responding to Geoffrey Hinton's warnings about potential AI-induced grid or financial failures, the author argues that a visible disaster is preferable to silent, total societal integration. The piece critiques mainstream regulatory narratives, suggesting that if AI evolves without obvious harm, humanity faces deeper structural risks regarding energy waste and intellectual erosion.

item.title: Chinese Firms Order 6M Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 Cards Amid Supply Crunch
item.description:
Major Chinese tech firms including Alibaba, Tencent, and ByteDance have ordered approximately 6 million Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 GPUs worth $70 billion, yet Nvidia can supply only about 1% within the next four months. Demand is driven by the card's compliance with US export limits and its 84GB GDDR7 memory, which enables single-card inference for 70B-parameter models. However, global production is capped at an estimated 3 million units in 2027 as TSMC capacity shifts to Rubin chips, creating a severe supply-demand gap.

原文标题：中国云厂商订购 600 万张 RTX Pro 5500 显卡 供需缺口巨大

Why it matters：揭示了地缘政治背景下高端 AI 算力硬件的极端供需失衡及具体技术规格对采购决策的影响。

Investors are questioning Google's ability to monetize AI effectively compared to its legacy search engine, triggering a ~14% drop in share price.

item.description:

Despite the clarification, the AI-driven memory shortage—dubbed the 'RAMpocalypse'—has already triggered price hikes in consumer hardware, fueling ongoing debates about resource allocation fairness.

item.title: 清华研究揭示 AI 智能体长期记忆删除机制严重失效
item.description:
清华大学最新论文指出，具备长期记忆的 AI 智能体在响应用户“遗忘”请求时几乎无法彻底清除数据。测试显示，6 种主流记忆系统在端到端删除任务中通过率不足 1.5%，且极易通过简单提示词被重新提取。该研究呼吁开发者必须构建并验证真实的底层删除路径，而非仅依赖表面确认消息。

Why it matters：揭示了当前 AI 智能体在隐私合规与数据生命周期管理上的核心缺陷，对开发者具有极高的警示价值。
